applications.name: Burnout
applications.description: Whenever the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Burnout Charge increasing their Special Attack by [16982bff]10%[-] per Charge. When the Defender has 10 or more Burnout Charges, 10 are removed and the Defender is passively Power Locked for 10 seconds. Whenever the Attacker activates Dexterity for any hit from the Defender's Special Attacks, the Defender gains an additional Burnout Charge.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Burnout Charge increasing their Special Attack by [16982bff]{1}%[-] per Charge. When the Defender has 10 or more Burnout Charges, 10 are removed and the Defender is passively Power Locked for {2} seconds. Whenever the Attacker activates Dexterity for any hit from the Defender's Special Attacks, the Defender gains an additional Burnout Charge.

applications.name: UNLIMITED POWER!
applications.description: For each Debuff the Defender has suffered since the start of the fight, every [16982bff]10[-] seconds they activate a permanent Fury Buff increasing their Attack by [16982bff]25%[-]. If these Fury Buffs are Nullified or removed in any way, the Defender gains [16982bff]15%[-] of their max Power for each Buff Nullfied.
applications.rawDescription: For each Debuff the Defender has suffered since the start of the fight, every [16982bff]{2}[-] seconds they activate a permanent Fury Buff increasing their Attack by [16982bff]{1}%[-]. If these Fury Buffs are Nullified or removed in any way, the Defender gains [16982bff]{0}%[-] of their max Power for each Buff Nullfied.

applications.name: Time to Strike
applications.description: Whenever the Defender would gain Power or Health while under the effects of a Heal Block or Power Lock, they are instead inflicted with a non-stacking Passive Degen dealing 100% of the Attackers Attack over 3 seconds.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender would gain Power or Health while under the effects of a Heal Block or Power Lock, they are instead inflicted with a non-stacking Passive Degen dealing {1}% of the Attackers Attack over {2} seconds.
